summary: Frontend-only regression of the NEW React web app (/app/frontend) that shares the existing FastAPI backend. All 20 requested flows verified end-to-end on desktop and mobile viewport as founder + a fresh test_ user. No critical or blocking issues found. One minor a11y warning in Radix Dialog.

issues: Radix warning: DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` — a11y-only, not a blocker. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/Live.jsx (DialogContent has no DialogDescription).

action_items: (Optional a11y polish) Add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to the 'Start an audio room' DialogContent in /app/frontend/src/pages/Live.jsx to silence the Radix warning. Same warning may appear in any other dialog without a description.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.refresh clears token on any /auth/me failure — including transient network errors this could log the user out silently. Consider only clearing on 401/403.

Live.jsx polls /rooms every 8s and Messages.jsx polls /conversations every 8s + /conversations/:id/messages every 4s. Fine short-term but a burnt-in interval with no visibility/tab-hidden gating will keep firing on background tabs. Consider gating on document.visibilityState==='visible' or SSE/WebSocket later.
Home.jsx PostCard link falls back to `/` when no author — should route to /login or hide the link entirely to avoid dead-clicks.
Forgot-password code branch: dev_code is intentionally rendered in the UI for sandbox mode (per PRD). Confirm this is stripped from prod builds when Resend goes out of sandbox.
